title: i want to get a recep of what all has been in the news about China and AI based

turns.user_message: i want to get a recep of what all has been in the news about China and AI based on my older blogs
turns.assistant_message: Added that to the scratchpad. Want me to develop it, or put a few angles on the board?

expected.why: No feedback on this turn — a raw idea on an empty scratchpad should be captured verbatim, not questioned or rewritten.

turns.user_message: What trends should I highlight for future growth?
turns.assistant_message: Put 5 angles on the board. Tell me which to run with (or mix two).

expected.why: No feedback — asking what to highlight should put distinct angles on the board, not pick one or write prose.

turns.user_message: Let's run with this angle: Economic Lens — Explore how China's investment in AI technologies is reshaping global markets and impacting international trade, appealing to business analysts and economists.
turns.assistant_message: Added that to the scratchpad. Want me to develop it, or put a few angles on the board?

expected.why: No feedback — picking an angle from the board is still a note-taking action, appended to the existing body.

turns.user_message: I want to write a 2 different blog posts - 1 citing the positive impacts and 1 focusing on all the negative things about china getting big in the AI race
turns.assistant_message: Added that to the scratchpad. Want me to develop it, or put a few angles on the board?

expected.why: No feedback — stating the '2 blogs, positive/negative' plan is still just a note being added, not a build request yet.

turns.user_message: can you build 2 blogs in the scratchpad, keep them short for now
turns.assistant_message: I can build a few things from your scratchpad — Blog outline (blog_outline); Social post (social_post); Marketing campaign (marketing_campaign). Which one?

feedback.comment:
I asked the system to generate 2 blogs, and put these in the scratch pad to get started. Instead I got this message as response  :"I can build a few things from your scratchpad — Blog outline (blog_outline); Social post (social_post); Marketing campaign (marketing_campaign). Which one?" - and nothing new 
added to the scratch pad

expected.why: User feedback: asking to 'build 2 blogs in the scratchpad' should develop scratchpad content directly, not ask a skill-menu clarifying question with nothing added. The real bug is in interpret's classification of this message (expand vs build), which a deterministic replay cannot test since it force-feeds the historical mode instead of classifying for real — see test_recorded_conversations_deepeval.py.

turns.user_message: can you generate outlines for now and the put it to the scratchpad
turns.assistant_message: Built a blog outline from v9 — see the Blog outline tab. 5 claims in it aren't in your sources — listed on the tab.

feedback.comment: The system generated a Blog outline - instead it should have only worked on the scratchpad. It should have waiting for the user to click on the "Blog outline" button to generate the blog outline.

expected.why: User feedback: 'generate outlines ... put it to the scratchpad' should only develop the scratchpad body. The actual Blog Outline artifact should only be built from an explicit button click (SkillBar in frontend/app/app/page.tsx), never from a conversational request. Same classification-layer limitation as turn 4.

turns.user_message: what are your sources for the blogs you've generated?
turns.assistant_message: The sources for the blog outlines are based on the angles and topics discussed in the scratchpad, but specific citations or references have not been provided yet. If you have any particular sources in mind or want to explore specific developments in China’s AI landscape, let me know!

feedback.comment:
The system did respond fine - but it changed the UI elements, the UI should not do anything unless the scratchpad - blog outline etc are being updated. these should be purely based on user action

also - since we are have a knowledge graph - it should have cited any facts take from there only.
The system did respond fine - but it changed the UI elements, the UI should not do anything unless the scratchpad - blog outline etc are being updated. these should be purely based on user action

expected.why: User feedback has two distinct issues. (1) The reply should cite facts from the knowledge graph when asked about sources — a live-model, content-judgable question, see test_recorded_conversations_deepeval.py. (2) The workspace UI (scratchpad/derived tabs) should never change on a plain chat turn — neither current test layer can check this (DeepEval only judges reply text, not UI state); it needs a browser-level test or manual verification, not built yet.
